items.title: Planning a Small Digital Business (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Planning a Small Digital Business (PDF 133, printed 129).

blocks.text: Chhote digital business ki planning mein khayalat ko ek wazeh aur qabil-e-amal plan mein munazzam karna shamil hai. Entrepreneurs pehle aisa product ya service pehchante hain jo customers ki zaroorat poori kare. Phir woh target audience (kin logon ke liye), qeemat (pricing) aur digital platforms ke zariye delivery ka tareeqa tay karte hain. Kharche aur mutawaqqa aamdani sambhalne ke liye ek basic budget banaya jata hai. Sahi planning yaqeeni banati hai ke business amli, munazzam aur digital market mein kamyabi ke zyada qareeb ho.

blocks.alt: Chaar qadam teeron se jure: 1. Product ya khidmat (gahak ki zaroorat poori kare); 2. Target audience (kin gahakon ke liye); 3. Qeemat aur delivery (digital platforms ke zariye); 4. Basic budget (kharch aur mutawaqqa aamdani).
blocks.caption: Chhote digital karobar ki mansooba bandi ke qadam (is sabaq ke liye hamara apna khaaka; kitab mein yeh tasveer nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neeche wali hamari tasveer kitab ke steps ko tarteeb se dikhati hai: product ya service chunein, target audience tay karein, qeemat (pricing) aur delivery ka tareeqa tay karein, phir budget banayein.

blocks.prompt: Chhote digital business ki planning ke steps tarteeb se likhein.
blocks.explanation: (1) Gahak ki zaroorat poori karne wala product ya service chunein. (2) Target audience tay karein. (3) Pricing aur digital platform par delivery ka tareeqa tay karein. (4) Kharch aur mutawaqqa aamdani ka basic budget banayein.

items: Planning: idea ko wazeh aur qabil-e-amal plan mein badalna.
Product -> audience -> pricing aur delivery -> budget.
